ePlane Company to Develop eVTOL Infrastructure at Noida Airport

The ePlane Company has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Noida International Airport to develop ground infrastructure for electric Vertical Take-Off and Landing (eVTOL) aircraft, also known as air taxis. This agreement aims to establish the necessary facilities for eVTOL operations at the airport.
